title: Schulische pH-Zuordnung mit Temperaturgrenze abrufen
titleEn: Recall school pH classification with its temperature limit
description: Die lernende Person kann die auf der Karte ausdrücklich temperaturgebundene schulische pH-Zuordnung verdünnter wässriger Lösungen mithilfe der zugehörigen Lernkarten sicher abrufen.
descriptionEn: The learner can reliably recall the expressly temperature-bound school pH classification of dilute aqueous solutions stated on the card using the associated flashcards.

memorySupportSelection.role: Recall of previously taught compact content only. No ordinary competency, source duty, acquisition performance, or Human evidence is certified.
memorySupportSelection.selectionSemantics: Unchanged getSrsFilterTags returns the existing goal: tags because no GK/LK or new selector tag is added. The unchanged card filter uses their OR intersection; actual ordered cards are checked, not inferred from selectedCardIds.
